description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Report on Review of the Balance Sheet of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka as at 31st March 2021
categorisation: This gazette content contains the Central Bank of Sri Lanka's balance sheet and the Auditor General's review report. This constitutes financial regulatory information and statutory reporting requirements, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory financial reporting by a government financial institution.
